title: 7/06 check-pick-entered sent a 'not entered — fix it now' DM for an undelivered, later-deferred double-down preview
tier_reason: the occurrence was a false entry alarm urging entry of a pick the system never delivered (entry hazard; no wrong entry evidenced); tier A by the B→A rule: deferred review findings on the same gate remain unfixed on the deployed path (load_decision does not check the record's own date, is_scoreable_commit ignores action, the checker reads {date}.json rather than the decision payload) and can change entry alerting under an inconsistent record

contract.text: check-pick-entered alerts only for a committed pick (delivered, private_locked or locked_unconfirmed) and only while it can still be submitted (before first pitch − 5 min); a preview or deferred candidate never triggers a 'not entered' DM.
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-07-06-deferred-dd-and-premature-entry-alert.md 'Bug (real, unambiguous)' and Recommendation 1; BTS rule 'submitted ≥ 5 minutes before first pitch' (same memo, confirmed by Eric)

mechanism.text: check_pick_entered treated the mere existence of {date}.json as a pick Eric had been told to enter; the scheduler rewrites that file all day with previews/projections, so at 13:30 ET it DM'd 'not entered … Fix it now!' for an undelivered double-down preview (should_lock=False) that the fallback deferred and deleted 16 minutes later

code.symbol: check_pick_entered (load_pick + window check, no commit gate)

mechanism.text: the DM countdown measured minutes to first pitch instead of the submission cutoff (first pitch − 5), and the firing window ran to first pitch, so a run in the final 5 minutes could nag for a pick that can no longer be submitted

residual.text: load_decision does not assert the record's internal date equals the requested date, and is_scoreable_commit ignores action (an inconsistent action=skip, scoreable=true record would alert and score) — deferred as corruption-class shared code; still so at HEAD.
residual.source: 540b1ab body; memo 'Codex pre-merge review … Deferred'; src/bts/daily_decision.py load_decision / is_scoreable_commit at HEAD

residual.text: The checker reads {date}.json, not the committed decision payload; a post-lock divergence would make it check the wrong player (low risk: the scheduler stops rewriting the file once locked).
private_locked / locked_unconfirmed with a failed best-effort decision.json write was not alerted (is_scoreable_commit falls back only to pick_was_delivered).
residual.source: memo 'Deferred' (HIGH); closed 2026-08-14 per ARCHITECTURE.md check-pick-entered ('Former residual limitation … closed'); I-209

residual.text: Crash between the preview write and the fallback defer could let the classification lock strand the undelivered preview once the early game starts (a no-pick day).
residual.source: memo Q2 and Recommendation 2(b); addressed 2026-08-30 by 3697512 F5 (stale preview archived as stale_pick_* and re-selected, I-084)

watchdog.trigger: an entry-check DM is sent for a date that has no scoreable commit (no decision record with scoreable=true and no delivery record) at send time, or is sent at or after the selection's submission cutoff
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every 'not entered' DM for the date refers to a committed, deliverable selection and was sent before first pitch − 5 min; the date's entry status is then confirmed or the day ends with an explicit skip/defer record

evidence.what: 13:10–13:21 the lineup check selected a double-down (projected primary, should_lock=False) and wrote {date}.json; 13:30:01 check-pick-entered found the file, 40 min before the earliest game, no entry → DM sent, marker {reason: no_pick, status: alerted}; 13:46:58 FALLBACK DEFERRED archived the pick and deleted the file; Eric flagged the DM as firing early

check-pick-entered treated the existence of {date}.json as 'a pick Eric was told to enter'; on 2026-07-06 it fired a premature 'not entered' DM for a deferred double-down 16 min before the scheduler deleted the pick
pre-merge review: the DM used the T−5 countdown while the window still ran to first pitch (negative countdown possible); window lower bound raised; three findings deferred
